title: Events

empty.title: No events match
empty.body: Widen the time window or clear pc / kind / source to see more rows. Agents emit events via the collect-winlog-events manifest; a freshly bootstrapped fleet may still be backfilling.

customRange.title: Range not set yet
customRange.incomplete: Set both the start and the end of the custom range to run the search. Nothing has been queried yet — this is "not searched", not "zero results".
customRange.inverted: The start is at or after the end. Move the start earlier than the end.

filters.forensicNote: logon_type only exists on collect-winlog-logons-all data and rows from before the Winlogon source switch; duplicates there are UAC split-token pairs.
filters.customHint: Set both bounds (minute precision; `to` is exclusive).

opTimeline.title: Operational state
opTimeline.subtitle: reconstructed from power / session / sleep / active events — gaps in a lane mean no event of that kind (e.g. powered off, or idle)

noEvidence.truncated: Unknown: {{from}} → {{to}} — the row limit was reached, so the older end of this period was never fetched. Raise the limit to see it
noEvidence.offline: Unknown: {{from}} → {{to}} — the agent stopped reporting, so its state over this stretch isn't known. Events backfill once it reconnects
noEvidence.noEvents: Unknown: {{from}} → {{to}} — no power / session / sleep / active events at all for this PC in this period. That means the state isn't known, not that it was off
noEvidence.agentDown: Unknown: {{from}} → {{to}} — the agent is recorded as having stopped reporting over this stretch. Whether the machine was off or only the agent had stopped is not distinguishable
noEvidence.agentDownHostOff: Unknown: {{from}} → {{to}} — the agent stopped reporting here, and came back on a machine that had rebooted in the meantime. The PC itself was away (shut down, suspended or without power)
noEvidence.agentDownAgentStopped: Unknown: {{from}} → {{to}} — the agent stopped reporting here, and came back on a machine that had NOT rebooted. The PC stayed up; only the agent had stopped
noEvidence.agentDownLinkOnly: Unknown: {{from}} → {{to}} — the agent stopped reporting here, but its own records for this stretch arrived afterwards, so it was running and observing throughout. The connection was down, not the PC. Anything still undelivered appears as it arrives
noEvidence.unrecordedShutdown: Unknown: {{from}} → {{to}} — the PC booted at the end of this stretch while it was still believed to be on, so it went down somewhere in here and nothing recorded when. An unclean power-off (power cut, hard reset, crash) logs no shutdown at all: Windows only notes it at the NEXT boot, which is where this stretch ends

opTimeline.truncated: row limit ({{limit}}) reached — nothing before {{from}} was fetched; the hatched part of each lane is window with no data
opTimeline.empty: No power / session / sleep / active events in this window for this PC.

chartPcCap: showing busiest {{shown}} of {{total}} PCs — narrow the filters for the rest

metaSearch.matchedNoEvents_one: {{count}} PC(s) match this metadata, but none have events in the selected period. Try widening the range.
metaSearch.matchedNoEvents_other: {{count}} PC(s) match this metadata, but none have events in the selected period. Try widening the range.
metaSearch.noPcMatched: No PC has metadata matching "{{text}}". The zero is about the search text, not about the fleet.
metaSearch.noMetadataAtAll: No PC has any metadata set, so this search can only ever return nothing. Set metadata on the Agents page or via the AD sync first.
